hook.say: True or false? Five mountain facts, three seconds each. Number five makes Everest look small!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Africa's highest mountain stands entirely in Tanzania.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Africa's highest mountain stands entirely in Tanzania.

questions.q: K2 is the second-highest mountain on Earth.
questions.fact: K2 rises 8,611 m. Only Mount Everest is higher.
questions.sayAnswer: True! K2 rises 8611 meters. Only Everest is higher.

questions.q: Every mountain above 8,000 metres is in Asia.
questions.say: Every mountain above 8000 meters is in Asia.
questions.fact: All 14 are in the Himalaya and Karakoram ranges.
questions.sayAnswer: True! All 14 of them are in the Himalaya and Karakoram ranges.

questions.q: Mount Everest sits on the border of Nepal and India.
questions.fact: Its summit is on the border between Nepal and China.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Its summit is on the border between Nepal and China.

questions.q: Measured from its base, Mauna Kea is taller than Mount Everest.
questions.fact: From the ocean floor, Hawaii's Mauna Kea rises more than 10,210 m.
questions.sayAnswer: True! From the sea floor, Hawaii's Mauna Kea rises more than 10000 meters.
